target.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases
target.body:
## Summary

- add browser-only `gpt-5.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol` aliases, both currently targeting ChatGPT's `GPT-5.6 Sol` entry
- keep the generic and pinned aliases distinct so the generic mapping can move when ChatGPT introduces a new default
- navigate through whichever GPT-5.x version submenu is currently visible, then strictly select and verify the inner Sol radio
- keep verified version evidence authoritative when the localized composer pill only shows an effort such as `极速`; missing or effort-only labels cannot self-verify as GPT-5.6 Sol
- report `switched` when a target row becomes checked after a click even if React leaves the localized effort pill unchanged
- reject bare GPT-5.6 aliases in API/multi-model paths while preserving provider-qualified custom-id passthrough
- keep unknown future variants such as `gpt-5.6-luna` from silently falling back to Sol

Fixes #305.

This complements the now-merged #304: that PR fixes the unified effort picker, while this PR adds first-class GPT-5.6 version routing and strict model-selection evidence.

Rebased onto current `main` at `7393c4f4`. Exact head: `e7e94183796950ab75ea2967736b03dd1166ecd2`.

## Tests

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/modelSelection.test.ts tests/cli/options.test.ts tests/cli/browserConfig.test.ts tests/runOptions.test.ts tests/cli/integrationCli.test.ts` — 250 passed
- `pnpm check` — passed
- `pnpm build` — passed
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pnpm vitest run --exclude tests/browser/profileCopy.test.ts` — 1,523 passed, 44 skipped; the excluded test requires system `rsync`
- browser API fail-fast smoke exits 1 with `GPT-5.6 Sol is browser-only today`

## Live browser validation

Validated through signed-in ChatGPT Pro browser profiles:

- English (US):
  - `--model gpt-5.6` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_EN_ALIAS_OK`
  - `--model gpt-5.6-sol` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_EN_SOL_OK`
- Chinese UI, with this PR combined with the picker behavior now merged through #304:
  - `--model gpt-5.6 --browser-thinking-time extended` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_ZH_EVIDENCE_FIXED_OK`
  - model evidence reported `requested=GPT-5.6 Sol; resolved=GPT-5.6 Sol; verified=yes`
  - the effort was independently confirmed as `Thinking time: 高 (already selected)`

No live test clicked or auto-clicked ChatGPT's "Answer now" control.
